response.rationale: Vaginal biopsy definitively shows endometrioid adenocarcinoma, directly establishing the diagnosis. Other candidates propose leiomyomatosis, contradicted by the biopsy findings of poorly differentiated epithelioid cells and positive cytokeratin/vimentin/CD138 with negative smooth muscle markers.

rejected.why: Biopsy shows adenocarcinoma, not leiomyomatosis; IHC negative for smooth muscle markers.
